result.summary: The home screen has several visual problems: a missing restaurant image, a cut-off restaurant name, an overlapping category chip, and a promo card that is clipped by the tab bar.

issues.description: The first card in Popular right now (Tokumaru Ramen Bar) shows a broken-image placeholder instead of a restaurant photo.
issues.suggestion: Load a valid restaurant image or a branded fallback so the card is not empty.

issues.description: The last restaurant in Fastest near you (Trattoria Piccol…) is clipped on the right, cutting off both the photo and the name.
issues.suggestion: Give the horizontal list enough padding or peek so the last card and title remain fully readable.

issues.description: The Healthy category chip is cut off at the right edge of the screen, so the last filter is only partially visible.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal inset or a fade so the last chip is fully readable or clearly scrollable.

issues.description: The pizza promo card at the bottom is overlapped by the tab bar, hiding the lower part of the image and content.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset so the last card sits fully above the navigation bar.
